subject: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@catalyze.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@catalyze.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro via Marissa last week. Catalyze Consulting is gearing up to embed Redwood into two vertical-focused delivery practices and we want to run a structured SI immersion for our solution architects and delivery leads. High level ask: a 3-day instructor-led bootcamp + a hands-on lab track and a lightweight certification exam that our team can use to badge engineers.

Key goals:
- Enable 12 consultants to deliver Redwood-backed POCs independently
- Provide a repeatable lab that maps to our typical customer workflows (chat agents + embeddings + reranking)
- Hand off runbooks and a simple certification we can run quarterly

I've attached a short workbook with our initial requirements and timelines (catalyze_requirements.xlsx). Proposed window: week of June 10 — would Redwood be able to support an on-site or virtually proctored run?

Appreciate any initial scope and ballpark commercial for a retainer + per-seat training model. Can loop legal/contracts after we lock scope.

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor Park
Head of Partnerships, Catalyze Consulting
eleanor.park@catalyze.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: catalyze_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet summary of desired outcomes and participant list)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@catalyze.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2029 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification

Hi Eleanor — great to meet you and thanks for the workbook.

Short answer: yes, we can run the program you described. Attached is an outline for a Redwood SI Immersion (redwood_si_immersion_outline.pdf) — it covers a 3-day instructor-led core track and an optional 2-day lab deep-dive. Highlights:
- Day 1: Core concepts and production-serving patterns (routing, caching, quantization)
- Day 2: Hands-on: deploying a sample reference solution with observability + cost controls
- Day 3: Advanced troubleshooting, rollouts, and certification prep
- Optional Lab: scenario-based exercises (chat agents, embeddings + reranker, privacy modes)

Proposed next steps:
1) We run a 30-minute alignment call next week to finalize outcomes and exact participant list
2) Redwood provides a mutual action plan + SOW draft for a retainer + per-seat add-on
3) We schedule a joint technical pre-read and sandbox access prior to the bootcamp

We're tentatively available the week of June 10 — Jonas (cc'd) will scope the lab resource needs. Marissa, can you chime in on pricing/partnership path?

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Partner Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_si_immersion_outline.pdf (high-level agenda and deliverables)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@catalyze.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2029 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification

Forwarding with partner-commercial suggestion.

Mateo / Jonas — Catalyze looks like a strategic boutique SI with a healthy pipeline. My commercial recommendation for a first engagement:
- 3-month enablement retainer (covers curriculum build, 3-day bootcamp delivery, 2 remote lab sessions, and certification package)
- Retainer fee: see draft pricing (redwood_si_pricing_retainer_v1.pdf) — propose a 20% introductory partnership discount for first cohort
- Per-seat cost after retainer for subsequent cohorts

If we do a retainer, we should include a clause for co-branded case study and a 90-day NPS checkpoint to measure success. Also propose a small success rebate tied to conversion of two POCs to paid deployments within 6 months.

Eleanor — if that sounds reasonable I can draft the SOW and loop Contracts. Jonas, can you confirm resource estimate (engineer-days) for the labs?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_si_pricing_retainer_v1.pdf (pricing sketch — internal draft)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@catalyze.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2029 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification

Thanks — quick tech note: resource ask for a 12-person cohort + 4 lab scenarios + 2 proctored lab sessions = ~8 engineer-days (split across delivery engineers and a dedicated SRE for sandbox ops).

Lab deliverables I'll provide:
- Pre-configured sandbox image and a script to provision datasets used in exercises
- Three scenario guides (chat agent with retrieval, embeddings + similarity rerank, latency-sensitive streaming)
- Certification exam (15 questions + two hands-on tasks) and grading rubric

Linking the lab schedule and resource calendar: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSI-Immersion

I'll attach the lab schedule & resource table in a separate note.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment: si_bootcamp_lab_schedule.xlsx (engineer-day breakdown and calendar slots)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Embedded Solutions Ops — SI Immersion & Certification

Marissa — thanks for the good framing. I approve moving forward on the retainer structure with the 20% introductory discount. Two quick asks before we send the SOW to Contracts:
1) Add a short SLA paragraph about sandbox uptime for instructor-led labs (target 99% availability during scheduled sessions).
2) Include a joint-case-study / co-marketing clause with a 30-day review window after publication.

Eleanor — if Catalyze can confirm the cohort date window and that Contracts can review a 3-month SOW, we'll publish a formal MSA + SOW draft. I've cc'd legal on Redwood's side to expedite (they'll reach out separately if they need edits).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Alliances & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
